question: Which of the following is the largest river island in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Majuli Island.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Majuli Island:**__

 __
 
• Majuli is the **largest inhabited riverine island in the world located in the Brahmaputra River.**
 
• It is India's **first Island district consisting of nearly 144 villages with a population of approximately 1.6 lakh.**
 
• It is a centre of Neo Vaishnavite culture initiated by Saint reformer Srimanta Sankardev in the 15th century.
 
• It has nearly** 65 Sattras** which is a religious and cultural institution.
 
• It is surrounded by the Subhasini river in the north, Brahmaputra river in the south, and Kherkutia islands in the northeast.
 
• It is mostly inhabited by the 'Mishing tribe'.
 
• Mishing, Assamese, and Deori are popular languages used on this Island.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gundu Island**__

 __
 
• Gundu is the **smallest island around Kochi with an area of 5 acres.**
 
• It is surrounded by coconut trees.
 
• It can be reached from Vypin island only by boat.
 
 
 
• **Divar Island**__
 __
 
• The Divar Island lies in the Mandovi river in the Indian state of Goa.
 
• It is located approx upriver 10 km from Panjim.
 
 
 
• **Diu Island **__
 
 
• It is an island off the southern coast of Gujarat's Kathiawar peninsula.
 
• The island lies 5 km to the east of Diu Head.
